description: This file defines the API controller class for the Opencart admin marketplace module. It contains methods to display the API page and to handle saving API credentials with validation and permission checks.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Controller class for managing API settings in the Opencart admin marketplace area.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language files and displays the API page with the current user token.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving API credentials, including permission checks, validation, and responding with success or error messages in JSON format.
